independent_acceptance.decisive_independent_check: Reconstructed u=s/epsilon in the area integral: I(-epsilon)*sqrt(epsilon) tends to 4sqrt(2)*int_0^1 sqrt(1/s-1) ds=2pi sqrt(2), with s^(-1/2) domination. The midpoint kinetic energy is 25epsilon/64; its action ratio tends to 9/4, while the zero-level comparison ratio tends to 8/5. The small-oscillation frequency is 8, giving Hessian limit 8I_2.
